title: Evidence ancestry guard
responsibility: Rejects evidence paths outside the trusted run directory or with a non-directory or symlink component beneath that root.

inputs.name: evidenceDirectoryFailure.directory
inputs.description: The evidence directory whose ancestry is checked; a relative value is resolved against the process working directory, and it must be root or a path beneath root, because any other location (such as a parent or sibling of root) returns the failure message. A path that does not exist yet reports no failure, because the walk stops at the first missing component.

inputs.name: evidenceDirectoryFailure.root
inputs.description: The trusted scratch directory that anchors the check; only root itself and the components beneath it are inspected with lstatSync, so symlinks above root are not checked. A root that is a symlink or a non-directory returns the failure message, and a missing root returns undefined unless the directory lies outside root.

outputs.name: evidenceDirectoryFailure
outputs.description: It is the ancestry failure message when the directory lies outside root, when an existing component is not a real directory (such as a file or a symlink), or when lstatSync fails with an error other than ENOENT. It is undefined when every component that exists is a real directory or the walk reaches a component that does not exist yet.
examples: capture directory ancestry must contain regular directories beneath the run root
